statements.impact_statement: The Marvin timing sidechannel leaks an RSA private key through the timing of RSA private-key operations. `rsa` 0.9 is a non-optional dependency of `pgp` 0.21 (rPGP), which `ferrohealth-openpgp-pq` uses to read and write OpenPGP packets. The crate performs no RSA operation of any kind: it accepts only ML-DSA-65+Ed25519 (RFC 9980 algorithm 30) keys and signatures, refusing any other algorithm with `Error::Algorithm` before a key is used or a signature is hashed (`CompositePublicKey::try_from`, `Certificate::verify`), and both halves of every signature it makes or checks run in `aws-lc-rs` (`crates/ferrohealth-openpgp-pq/src/composite.rs`). rPGP's signing and verification only reach the crate's own `SigningKey` and `VerifyingKey` implementations. The test `refusals::keys_of_another_algorithm_are_refused_before_any_rpgp_cryptography` and the source check `refusals::the_crate_names_no_rpgp_public_key_primitive` hold this. DELETING EVENT: an rPGP release on `rsa` 0.10, which fixes the advisory; upgrade the day it ships.

The advisory concerns crypto-bigint 0.5 operations meant to be constant-time that can branch on their operands, which leaks only when an operand is secret. The crate is reached through `cx448` (Ed448) and `elliptic-curve` 0.13 (the ECDSA curves `p256`, `p384`, `p521` and `k256`), all carried by `pgp` 0.21 (rPGP) as non-optional dependencies. `ferrohealth-openpgp-pq` runs none of that arithmetic: it accepts only ML-DSA-65+Ed25519 (RFC 9980 algorithm 30) keys and signatures, refusing an ECDSA, Ed448 or any other key or signature with `Error::Algorithm` before it is used, and computes both halves of every signature in `aws-lc-rs`. The test `refusals::keys_of_another_algorithm_are_refused_before_any_rpgp_cryptography` and the source check `refusals::the_crate_names_no_rpgp_public_key_primitive` hold this. DELETING EVENT: an rPGP release on `elliptic-curve` 0.14 and `crypto-bigint` 0.6 (rpgp/rpgp#573); upgrade the day it ships.
